import sqlite3,tempfile,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path('/Users/greg/Dev/flop-router')
sql=(repo/'docs/router-legacy-generation-lg2-schema.sql').read_text()
results=[]
for n in (1000,10000,100000,161073):
 for locator_bytes in (0,64):
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='lg2-contract-',dir='/private/tmp') as t:
   db=sqlite3.connect(str(Path(t)/'model.sqlite'))
   db.executescript('PRAGMA page_size=4096;PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;CREATE TABLE messages(projection_row_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY);'+sql)
   # No production records: stable synthetic binary identities; model 32,890/161,073 extra witnesses.
   extra=round(n*32890/161073)
   for start in range(0,n,500):
    values=[]; reports=[];witnesses=[]
    for i in range(start,min(start+500,n)):
     raw=hashlib.sha256(('raw-'+str(i)).encode()).digest()
     values.append(('sm1:'+raw.hex(),));reports.append((raw,i%2))
     for kind in (1,2) if i<extra else (1,):
      digest=hashlib.sha256((str(kind)+'-cache-'+str(i)).encode()).digest()
      locator='' if not locator_bytes else hashlib.sha256(('locator-'+str(kind)+'-'+str(i)).encode()).hexdigest()
      witnesses.append((raw,kind,digest,locator))
    db.executemany('INSERT INTO messages VALUES (?)',values)
    db.executemany('INSERT INTO legacy_generation_reports(raw_ref,reported_code) VALUES (?,?)',reports)
    db.executemany('INSERT INTO legacy_generation_witnesses VALUES (?,?,?,?)',witnesses)
   db.commit()
   assert db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall()==[('ok',)]
   assert not db.execute('PRAGMA foreign_key_check').fetchall()
   stats=db.execute("SELECT name,sum(pgsize),sum(payload) FROM dbstat WHERE name IN ('legacy_generation_reports','legacy_generation_witnesses') GROUP BY name").fetchall()
   pages=sum(x[1] for x in stats);payload=sum(x[2] for x in stats)
   results.append(dict(rows=n,witnesses=n+extra,explicit_locator_bytes=locator_bytes,table_bytes=pages,record_payload_bytes=payload,sqlite_overhead_bytes=pages-payload,bytes_per_row=pages/n,tables=stats))
   db.close()
print(json.dumps(dict(scope='Synthetic compact-table allocation model, not full projection or production qualification. 4096-byte pages, no VACUUM, SHA-random synthetic keys. Model witness multiplicity 1+32890/161073. Parent messages storage excluded: unchanged shared data.',sqlite_version=sqlite3.sqlite_version,ddl_sha256=hashlib.sha256(sql.encode()).hexdigest(),results=results),indent=2))
